args: Japan Women's Open: Katie Boulter vs Himeno Sakatsume

This market refers to the tennis match between Katie Boulter and Himeno Sakatsume in the Japan Women's Open, originally scheduled for October 18, 2026 at 9:00PM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Katie Boulter' if Katie Boulter advances against Himeno Sakatsume.

This market will resolve to 'Himeno Sakatsume' if Himeno Sakatsume advances against Katie Boulter.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or a winner has not been determined by November 1, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one player advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the player who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the WTA Tour. A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

In the upcoming game, scheduled for October 20, 2026
If Liverpool FC wins, this market will resolve to "Yes".
Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve "No".
This market refers only to the outcome within the first 90 minutes of regular play plus stoppage time.

The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. However, if the governing body or event organizers have not published final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, data from Flashscore may be used; if Flashscore data is unavailable, data from Sofascore may be used; if neither is available, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead. All markets will settle based on the official final result as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. Revisions to officially declared final scores made after market resolution will not be accounted for in determining the outcome. If no acceptable data is available within 24 hours of the event's conclusion, this market will resolve 50-50, or to "Draw" where applicable.

# garden/v7's module path. Deploy status is deliberately NOT here -- see garden/v2's for why.
# For live status read TESTNET.md: this is a build input and cannot be trusted about the chain.
#
# WHAT v7 IS: garden/v6 plus exactly ten changes, each named in garden.gno's "WHAT v7 IS" block
# and in DESIGN.md: batch 60; five rolled axes plus born-under; the dominance order as five
# explicit slots; four stats from a 546-row set enumerated at init(); a secret id with the
# first-seventeen-distinct rule; a rolled care threshold with NO getter; LINEAGE.md's 84 kinship
# edges as structure only; seedFor from FNV-1a to SHA-256; (9, 2026-10-18) the named-edition odds
# off batchCap onto namedPickRange = 10, 1-in-10 per claimant, not 1-in-60; and (10, same day)
# the roster 3 -> 8 one-of-ones at those same odds, existing characters renamed, no new art.
# A GUARANTEE is a different thing, written 2026-10-17 and REMOVED 2026-10-18 (AUDIT-01 RED-1);
# nothing shipped in its place. Read garden.gno's package doc first: v5 survived an audit, v6 was
# a surgical copy, anything beyond those ten is unreviewed.
#
# (Hard 4096-byte toolchain limit; `gno test` refuses a longer file. Detail is in garden.gno.)
#
# Checklist before deploying. 0-6 are v5's, 7-9 are v6's -- still outstanding after three
# versions -- and 10-14 are v7's.
#
#  (0) sale constants CONFIRMED FOR ONYX 2026-10-19: 5% + 1 GNOT floor, recipient is the
#      gnotchi-opponent key we hold. RE-DECIDE FOR MAINNET: a test key is the wrong recipient
#      for real money, and a 1 GNOT floor exceeds 5% on any sale under 20.
#  (1) adminAddress is the onyx key `gnotchi-deploy`. Change it for anywhere real; there is no
#      admin-transfer function, by design.
#  (2) imports beacon/v2 from the OTHER namespace (g1r4aw43...), as v5/v6 do -- that import
#      works and must not be "fixed"; cannot deploy where it is not live.
#  (3) numEyes/numNoses/hat/coat catalogue must match the art side exactly.
#  (4) batchCap (60) and the roster hob/thistle/wick/tally/glim/vigil/spruce/yonder are
#      BATCH-ONE.md's; the eight appear in namedEditionOrder, namedEditionDisplayNames AND
#      reservedNameKeys, and List's lock message says "eight" -- FOUR edits, not three.
#  (5) lockCaredDays SETTLED 2026-10-19 at 14 (was 30). Pinned by its own test; the two List
#      tests are value-agnostic.
#  (6) genesisGnomeName SETTLED 2026-10-19: Sprig. The canonical form is in reservedNameKeys
#      AND the character slug, which the realm asserts must equal the name.
#  (7) maxNameLen (24) must equal app/js/config.js's NAME_MAX_LEN. Hand-maintained.
#  (8) renaming allowed, names unique: the SHAPE of SetName and nameOwner, not constants.
#  (9) combining-mark exclusion: open product question (NOTES.md, v4 Y7). Mainnet, not onyx.
# (10) THE BADGER: APPROVED 2026-10-19, reasoning in TRAITS.md 8. Secrets 1 and 4 aim at it and
#      are the O and E of DONTEATYELLOWSNOW, so cutting it costs two of the seventeen.
# (11) the nine kinship type WORDS are on chain (KinTypeName) -- a declared judgement call. For
#      the strict reading, drop KinTypeName and TotalKinTypes; nothing else moves.
# (12) GAS MEASURED 2026-10-19: 343,689,400, 8.7x under onyx MaxGas. AUDIT-02's byte model said
#      ~345M -- right to 0.4%. DEPLOY VIA ops/stage-realm.sh: addpkg uploads *_test.gno too,
#      which doubles gas to 677M and puts 258 KB of tests on chain for ever.
# (13) NO named-edition guarantee -- removed 2026-10-18, AUDIT-01 RED-1. Residual miss rate
#      ACCEPTED (1.43% of full batches). Never add a claim expiry, settle deadline or
#      stale-claim sweep: each puts a permanent hole in the acrostic.
# (14) the seed derivation changed, so a given (round, claimant) does NOT produce v5's or v6's
#      gnome. seedDomain must never be edited after deploy: changing it re-rolls everybody.
#
# MUST NOT use the arcade/... prefix (ARCADE.md 4.7, NOTES.md).
module = "gno.land/r/g1nq99m3h9ed7vqve6ajpr3qwy2ls252m8jnundm/garden/v7"
gno = "0.9"
